surface: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY / ChatGPT guide representative sample

readerContract.humanQuestion: How do I use the ChatGPT account I actually have to finish a useful job, and what do I do when a tool limit or wrong revision interrupts it?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader can set up a bounded job, choose the available route honestly, inspect the real output, give a precise correction and leave with a checked deliverable.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No technical background, paid plan or familiarity with Projects, Work or Codex is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: ChatGPT is a product with different models, modes, tools and permissions; success comes from matching the route to the job and checking the artifact, not from one magic prompt.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The sample turns supplied notes and costs into a workshop plan, budget and invitation without buying, sending or publishing anything.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A current scannable user manual and worked reference for ChatGPT, not a general AI workflow book or product advertisement.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know what to click, what to provide, what the result proves and how to recover when the first revision is wrong.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Any change to the guide job, Free route or comparison boundary.
Before drafting and whenever models, plans, settings, tools or privacy controls change.
Any change to official model, effort, prompt, context, permission, Skill or surface guidance.
If any preserved run, checker result or setup record changes.
Any change to reference-book teaching requirements.
Any change to LAiDIES public prose rules.

strengthsToUse: Answer the actual product question first.
Separate observed behaviour, documented access and unknown limits.
End with a useful reader move and recheck trigger.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not copy the FAQ structure across the guide.
Do not inherit any unrelated dated claim.
Do not turn every workflow into the same template.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Introduce Chat, Work, Codex, model and effort only when the reader must make that decision.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The sample begins with the workshop job and reveals controls at the point of use.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Use one complete job with interruptions and repairs rather than repeated feature cards.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The sample follows the actual Free run and its failed revision.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: No product analogy is authorized for this sample.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The mechanism is shown through the real interface route and artifacts.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Practitioner guidance appears only where it changes an action or check.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The sample attributes the specific-feedback method once and labels the adaptation.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Explain how source facts, requested outputs, tool availability, artifact inspection and correction interact.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: Every stage names its input, visible output and verification.

genericAction.producerGuard: The reader leaves with exact copied inputs, prompt, correction and checked figures.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The action produces a bounded workshop pack.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Describe the task decision before naming product layers or effort controls.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: The opening begins with the Free account route.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Connect settings, context, tools, outputs and checks as one workflow.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The actual revision failure demonstrates why the pieces cannot be treated separately.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use the recognisable annoyance of a confident completion summary beside a stale table, without mocking the reader.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The sample gives a recovery route instead of a compliance lecture.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: The workshop is a reusable method demonstration, not the whole purpose of ChatGPT.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: Transfer notes map the method to other bounded documents and files.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open with the reader's need to finish work using the account she has.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: Product taxonomy follows the practical problem.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Name which lessons transfer and which facts belong only to the workshop fixture.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The closing separates method from case details.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write as a candid capable colleague, not a software manual or product review blog.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Interface terms are translated through decisions and consequences.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Start in the simplest available ChatGPT route, provide a small source-of-truth packet and exact deliverables, inspect the files themselves, then correct the smallest proven defect without rebuilding everything.
causalSequence: Orient the reader to Free Chat and the task before discussing paid options.
Show the exact source packet, prompt and requested checks.
Inspect the produced proposal and evidence rather than trusting the completion summary.
Expose the stale-budget failure and give the exact targeted correction.
Verify the corrected figures and explain when a paid or agentic route would and would not help.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: The actual ChatGPT Free workshop-pack run, its data-analysis limit, failed 22-person revision and successful targeted repair.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: Revise a different small plan after one source fact changes, preserving unaffected text and checking every dependent figure or statement.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Copy the complete source packet and prompt, run it only with fictional or permitted material, inspect the visible outputs, then use the correction pattern on one concrete defect.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Let the stale table beside a confident summary provide the earned irony; do not add decorative jokes.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: A short orientation card, complete worked job, what actually happened, exact repair, Free/paid boundary, transfer checklist and dated sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The sample is a narrated case with artifacts and decisions, not a stack of identical feature descriptions or prompt formulas.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Make the invisible difference between chat text, tool-created files, evidence and actual artifact state visible through one real workflow.

humanQuestion.reason: Readers need to finish a job with the account they have.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open with the Free route and its actual result.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A correct-looking summary can accompany a wrong file.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Invite the reader to compare the proposal table with evidence before revealing the defect.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Tool limits and revision propagation are otherwise hidden.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Show the exact before-and-after figures and file state.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Product terms matter only when they change the route.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from ordinary Chat to Work or Codex only when permissions or execution differ.

limitationsConsequences.reason: One observed Free account is not every reader's entitlement.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Keep observation, documentation and unknown quota separate.

humourSurprise.reason: The confident summary/wrong table contrast clarifies the lesson.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Use one restrained line after the reader sees both artifacts.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader needs a recovery habit.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End with which artifact still contains the old value and what depends on it.

explanationArc.adaptation: The reference uses a complete case and exact repair while retaining quick lookup routes.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The guide could promise unavailable controls, present a polished demo as reliability or imply that paying prevents factual errors.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Draft the complete Free workshop case, preserve the failed revision and show the exact repair beside a truthful paid-route boundary.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A reader can choose the observed Free route, identify why the revision failed and issue a targeted correction without buying a plan or restarting the whole job.
